g.title: APIOps architecture
g.desc: Two alternative inputs converge in a Git repository: extract-first from a source Azure API Management instance, or code-first CLI-compatible API Management artifacts. The workflow creates a configuration change, reviews and validates it, and approves an immutable deployment input. A platform-neutral CI/CD workflow previews the approved input with apiops publish dry-run, publishes and promotes it with apiops publish, then validates and reconciles the target API Management environments.
